title: pleiocardia tortuosa
intro: Pleiocardia tortuosa, commonly known as the Indian cordia, is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Pleiocardia tortuosa are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which help in reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and modulating immune responses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include cardenolides, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects, although further research is needed to fully elucidate its pharmacological properties.
